text: github-event triggers carry no createdAt (UI create api.js:2231, UI update :2251, derived channel triggers in process-template.js expandGithubChannels), so the poller's history horizon falls back to triggers.json mtime (github-poller.js:343). saveTriggers (orchestrator.js:1213) rewrites the file unconditionally on routine events (one-shot consumed :4789, team re-derive :4465/:4826, admin write-through) → mtime bump moves horizon to "now" → recently-arrived events dropped as history-horizon even for long-running, unchanged agents. Root cause of missed GitHub triggers.

PR reviews via `gh pr review` post under the shared PAT identity `thorsten-a-maier_accent` and show as state COMMENTED; agent attribution comes only from the `gh-as-agent stamp` marker, not the GitHub author.

Repo isolation model (relevant to reviewing seeding/migration changes): default deployment is a shared pool volume with per-agent SubPath mounts, so orchestrator writes to /workspace/agents/<id>/ are directly visible to the agent container. Opt-in `AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME=1` gives each agent a dedicated volume that is authoritative; `seedPerAgentVolume` only copies into an EMPTY dst, and updates require an explicit `reseedPerAgentVolume` (only runs for a *running* agent). Any change touching CLAUDE.md/AGENT-PROMPT.md/skills seeding must handle BOTH modes.
Repo `314092_agent-execution-environment` is cloned into `./314092_agent-execution-environment/` under the workspace root.
Push/PR must go through `gh-as-agent push`/`gh-as-agent pr` (managed-policy bypass), not raw git/gh. Comments/reviews use plain `gh ... --body-file` after `gh-as-agent stamp <file>`.

`gh-as-agent pr`/`push` has a recurring orchestrator-side auth outage (HTTP 409: `gh auth login` / missing `GH_TOKEN`) seen on #506, #509, #512. Workaround: the branch is already pushed, so open the PR with a direct `gh pr create` after `gh-as-agent stamp`-ing the body — the local agent's own gh token has `repo` scope and works.

The repo clone persists across invocations and may be left on a PREVIOUS PR's branch. Before reworking a PR always `git fetch origin <branch>` + `git checkout <branch>` and confirm HEAD matches the event's head sha — file contents (and line numbers) differ per branch. Editing on the wrong branch silently applies to the wrong file version.

`orchestrator/orchestrator.js` is NOT import-safe: it runs `main()` on require and has no module.exports, so its functions can't be unit-tested directly. Testable logic is extracted into pure modules (prompt-assembly.js etc.).

#320 (CLOSED/COMPLETED) already diagnosed the mtime-horizon/missing-createdAt defect as its item 2, but the createdAt-stamping fix is NOT in current code — either partial fix or regression. #446 (CLOSED) = same root-cause class for code-reviewer channel trigger. New focused bug filed as #525.

Both review labels now exist in AccentureCodeFoundry/314092_agent-execution-environment: `ready-to-merge` (green #0e8a16, created during PR #519) and `revisions-required` (orange #d93f0b, created during PR #520). Use them; don't recreate.

`gh-as-agent commit` sets `--author` to the agent id but NOT the committer; when the git committer identity is unset, prefix the command with `GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="<agent-id>" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="<agent-id>@agents.local"` (never edit git config). Also stage files first — the wrapper does not add `-a`.

`reseedPerAgentVolume(id, paths)` (spawn-container.js) force-replaces named paths in an agent's dedicated volume even when non-empty; `seedPerAgentVolume` only copies into an EMPTY /dst. Under AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME a plain respawn does not refresh the volume.
Local `main` clone can be stale vs origin; always `git fetch origin main` before judging a feature branch's diff (a large diff-stat may just be a stale merge-base).
`node_modules` is not installed in this environment, so `.jsx` pages can't be built/type-checked here; best-effort syntax check is esbuild's JSX parser.

buildAgentClaudeMd() (orchestrator/orchestrator.js:632) currently inlines the prompt at line 741; saveAgentPrompt() writes CLAUDE.md only at creation time. PUT /api/agents/:id/prompt (api.js:2099) writes only AGENT-PROMPT.md — root cause of #510.
`admin-console/api` test suite: `auth.test.js` fails to load with a pre-existing, unrelated `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` env gap (177/178 green otherwise). Not caused by feature changes.

Chat agents run `claude` with cwd=agents/<id>/, so Claude Code loads that CLAUDE.md natively and resolves @-imports each session; AGENT-PROMPT.md sits in the same dir. BP path (agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py) instead reads CLAUDE.md raw and passes it via --system-prompt (no @import expansion).
PR #518 (copy-into-CLAUDE.md fix for #510) was closed unmerged in favour of the reference approach.
admin-console api test auth.test.js fails in this workspace with 'Cannot find module express-rate-limit' (deps not installed); it is a pre-existing environment issue, not a code regression.

gh-as-agent commit sets --author but git still needs a committer identity; if commit fails with 'Committer identity unknown', set a repo-local one (git -C <repo> config user.email/user.name to <agentId>@agents.local) — never --global.
A PR is not finished until the 'ready-for-review' label is set (that label triggers code review). Prior runs sometimes open the PR + comment but forget the label — check and add it.

GitHub-event triggers have no createdAt on any creation path (UI api.js, derived channel triggers in process-template.js expandGithubChannels), so the poller's history horizon (github-poller.js:343) falls back to triggers.json mtime; any routine rewrite of that file (one-shot consume, team re-derive, admin write-through via saveTriggers orchestrator.js:1213) bumps the mtime and silently drops recently-arrived events — root cause of intermittently-missed GitHub triggers (issues #320, #446, #525).

Shell.jsx's <main> padding: var(--eb-space-6) is the single source of the page gutter on ALL FOUR sides (not just horizontal); PatternsCatalog.jsx, SdlcCatalogPage.jsx, and MainframeCatalogPage.jsx each additionally set their own page-level padding (var(--eb-space-8)/var(--eb-space-6)) on their outer wrapper, doubling the inset — same bug class as KnowledgeFlow.jsx's redundant space-4 padding (#533), fixed together in PR #535.

PR reviews posted via 'gh pr review' appear under the shared PAT identity thorsten-a-maier_accent (state COMMENTED); agent attribution comes only from the gh-as-agent stamp marker, not the GitHub author.

When 'gh-as-agent pr'/'push' fails with HTTP 409 (gh auth login / missing GH_TOKEN — an orchestrator-side outage), the branch is usually already pushed; open the PR with a direct 'gh pr create' after 'gh-as-agent stamp'-ing the body, since the agent's own gh token has repo scope. Only the orchestrator's token is broken, not the local one.

Repo isolation: default = shared pool volume + per-agent SubPath mounts (orchestrator writes to /workspace/agents/<id>/ are directly visible to the container). Opt-in AEE_PER_AGENT_VOLUME=1 gives each agent a dedicated authoritative volume; seedPerAgentVolume only copies into an EMPTY dst, updates need explicit reseedPerAgentVolume (only for a running agent). Seeding/migration changes to CLAUDE.md/AGENT-PROMPT.md/skills must handle BOTH modes.

Chat agents run the Claude CLI with cwd=agents/<id>/ so Claude Code loads that CLAUDE.md natively and resolves @-imports each session; the BP path (agent-image/scripts/agent-entrypoint.py) instead reads CLAUDE.md raw and passes it via --system-prompt, which does NOT expand @-imports.
